svg.text: Control what Memory Trail remembers, where it is stored, and review its local-first privacy model.
Remember app switches and focused windows
Clipboard capture is enabled by default. When enabled, copied text is stored in the local timeline; you can turn it off at any time.
Local by design • transparent by default
Memory Trail keeps its core timeline workflow on this computer: capture, processing, storage, summaries,
and Ask Memory Trail search are performed locally.
Foreground app/window context and copied text (when enabled) are read from Windows APIs on this PC.
Titles, categories, duplicate detection, summaries, active-time calculations, and Ask Memory Trail searches are handled inside the app.
Captured timeline history is not uploaded or synchronized by Memory Trail and is not sent to analytics or advertising providers.
Review the source code and privacy implementation on GitHub from About Memory Trail.
